purpose: Pins the canonical serialization hashed into <machine-key>, the suffix of <user-config>/lm3/<deployment>/hardware_settings.<machine-key>.yaml.
algorithm: key = sha256(serialized utf-8).hexdigest()[:16]. The serialization is four lines, each terminated by '\n', always present, in this order: 'machine-key/v1', 'os-machine-id: <value>|none', 'node: <SLURM_NODENAME or hostname>', 'gpu-uuids: <sorted UUIDs joined by ",">|none'.
notes: node: is UNCONDITIONAL, never merely a fallback -- that is what separates two containerized nodes sharing one baked /etc/machine-id (gate 20).
Driver versions, ORT/provider versions, selected devices, enabled stages and model fingerprints must NOT enter the key; they are staleness fields inside the profile.
